periods.time: After special conscription, before Harima's identity is known at Wakaba House

name.zh: 奥羽和贺岳确认大炎脱逃
name.en: Great Flame's escape is confirmed at Ohu-Wagadake

periods.summary: Followers of the Heaven-Guided Sect try to raid the secret prison that holds their教主, but Kurono captures them. Itsuki Kurogane inspects the facility, learns its management system was briefly down during Or-Gaule's chaos, and insists on opening Cocytus despite the warden's objections. The cell is empty: Great Flame, Harima Tendo, has escaped.
periods.cause: A short system failure during the Or-Gaule crisis may have created an almost impossible escape window for a prisoner dangerous enough to require Cocytus.
periods.process: Itsuki explains Tendoushu's pro-war doctrine and the Occupation of the Imperial Hotel to Kurono, authorizes her forbidden World Crisis as a last resort, then opens the multilayer cryogenic cell with Iron Blood Phalanx.
periods.outcome: Harima's absence is confirmed, and Itsuki orders an emergency notification to headquarters.
periods.significance: Reveals the true national threat behind the volume: the escaped Great Flame, a terrorist leader more dangerous than ordinary fugitives.
